ThingDef.label: fractured precursor diagnostic console
ThingDef.description: A dead precursor diagnostic station. Its pale ceramic shell is split across a dark interface seam and only fragments of the original field-channel geometry remain. Whatever data it once held is no longer directly accessible.

ThingDef.label: fractured precursor containment cradle
ThingDef.description: The broken ring of a precursor laboratory containment apparatus. Several field vanes have sheared away and the central chamber is empty, leaving a precise but useless shell around a darkened emitter bed.

ThingDef.label: inert precursor drone rack
ThingDef.description: A damaged storage-and-service rack built for compact precursor drones. Most sockets are empty and the launch-control channels are dead. An occasional intact drone may survive nearby, but the rack itself can no longer arm, guide or manufacture anything.

ThingDef.label: collapsed precursor field projector
ThingDef.description: A laboratory-scale field projector whose stabilising arms have collapsed inward. The emitter is cold, its geometry incomplete and its containment function irrecoverable without first understanding the underlying precursor systems.
